text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hauu... Getting injured is
Falco's biggest blunder ever☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I won't be able to race or perform in the live.
What should I do...?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Still, maybe just a little bit will be okay...☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just some light choreography practice.
Come on, please? Trainer-san♪
choice_data_list: Let's get some rest — for your fans' sake too.
Alright, let's tough it out with guts!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... True, if my injury got worse...
all the fans might be really sad...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, no good, no good!
Falco wasn't thinking enough like an Umadol☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Uuugh~☆ But still, but still!
It's driving me crazy~☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though Smart Falcon understood it intellectually, she couldn't settle down,
so I did my best to soothe her.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All riiight, that's the spirit☆
Let's head to the studio right away♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...This might be way worse than I thought!
Falco is in huge trouble?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Deciding that pushing her was out of the question,
I had Smart Falcon take a rest."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer-san♪
You totally get how Falco feels☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
One, two♪ One, two♪
Yep, doing great☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco will keep running as an Umadol♪
I can't afford to stop now☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was thoroughly impressed watching Smart Falcon
already stepping so lightly and gracefully.
